headline: EU FSD adoption surges — Dutch users alone drive 10M km in first month after Netherlands RDW approval; one city in one country generating more FSD miles than most national fleets combined; signals explosive European subscriber uptake ahead of summer EU-wide vote; Tesla ending one-time purchase option in Netherlands May 15, funneling new EU owners into €99/month ARR pipeline

Tesla FSD update 2026.14 renders European-style vehicles in visualization for first time — cab-over semi-trucks and regional vehicle silhouettes now accurately displayed on EU center screens; quiet but meaningful step toward EU-wide FSD deployment readiness; signals neural network is being trained on European road environments, not just US data

SpaceX formally files plan revealing Terafab chip factory costs $55B–$119B — joint Tesla/SpaceX semiconductor facility in Texas enters formal planning phase; research fab at Giga Texas (~$3B) will produce AI5-class chips in small batches; full Terafab scope $55B minimum with total exceeding $119B; Intel 14A process confirmed; SpaceX filing notes 'no assurance' on timeline execution; one of the largest private infrastructure investments in history if fully built

Germany April 2026 best April ever for Tesla — 3,149 units, 1.3% overall market share, 4.9% of BEV segment; BEV national penetration hit 25.8%; +256% YoY vs April 2025, +142% vs January 2026; highest first-month-of-quarter since Q1 2024 (9 quarters); YTD already at 82% of full-year 2025 total; last 3 months +188% vs Nov–Jan; EU recovery now structural across all major markets

Tesla files two new Roadster trademarks with USPTO — stylized wordmark + distinctive triangular badge filed May 1, 2026; badge departs sharply from Tesla's standard T-bar identity; Electrek calls it 'clearest signal yet' Tesla is preparing to bring the long-delayed supercar to market; aligns with Musk's 'month or so' reveal hint from Apr 23 earnings call; summer 2026 unveil now appears imminent

Tesla China-made EV sales jump 36% YoY in April to 79,478 units — sixth consecutive monthly gain as recovery accelerates from 2025 lows; figures include GigaShanghai exports to Europe and other markets; Reuters notes FSD approval delays and aggressive Chinese rival launches as potential limits on further momentum; Q2 delivery pace now well above Q2 2025 baseline

Tesla Semi filmed hauling first Cybercab delivery batch out of Giga Texas — multiple Cybercabs secured on flatbed trailer being transported by a production-spec Semi (82,000 lbs GCW); follows 60 units staged in outbound lot on Apr 30; first documented delivery run confirms Cybercab manufacturing cadence advancing from pilot builds to active distribution; units likely heading to fleet staging and testing sites

WattEV orders 370 Tesla Semi trucks in $100M deal — California's largest-ever single electric truck order; 50 units to be delivered in 2026 with full fleet by end of 2027; 300+ trucks supporting Port of Oakland freight electrification; WattEV CEO said Tesla Semi was chosen based on 'cost, performance, and availability' in a public RFP process — signals accelerating enterprise fleet adoption as Nevada production ramps

EU FSD bloc-wide vote set for July 2026 at earliest — no vote scheduled this week; Tesla faces Nordic bloc skepticism over speeding allowance, icy road performance, and hands-free driving at 80 km/h; TCMV requires 55% of member states + 65% of EU population to approve; Reuters/Ars Technica/Electrek report October 2026 as likely backup date; Netherlands now sharing approval details via non-public regulatory exchange; individual nations may provisionally approve ahead of bloc-wide vote; Tesla needs 15 of 27 EU member states to say yes

Austin robotaxi unsupervised fleet hits 38 vehicles — Austin: 27 (majority of 53 total Austin fleet), evening operations now confirmed; 47.8% of Austin trips unsupervised in last 7 days; fleet ramp accelerating across Dallas and Houston as well; Sunday set new sighting record across all 3 TX cities; signals growing FSD confidence across varied lighting and traffic conditions
source: RtaxiTracker / NextBigFuture / Not a Tesla App
